description: HyDesign, published by Technical University of Denmark, evaluates and optimizes hybrid power plants combining wind, solar, storage and power-to-hydrogen. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The model distinguishes ideal operation from degradation- and forecast-error-affected operation. A case result depends on that choice and on cost, weather and market inputs. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
